capabilities: Browse notes by folders, tags and properties in a single- or dual-pane navigator
Filter and search notes by names, tags, properties, dates, folders and tasks
Create, move, merge, delete and pin notes, including folder notes and tag operations
Open daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and yearly notes from a calendar
Create notes from built-in or Templater templates with folder templates and prompts
extras: Licensed under GPLv3; pull requests are not accepted, only feature requests. Some optional features make documented HTTP requests (update checks, icon packs, external images, language packs). Full documentation, FAQ and Discord are linked externally.
intentEvidence: A better file browser and calendar inspired by Apple Notes, Bear, Evernote and Day One.
problem: Obsidian's built-in file browser shows only folders, without tag or property browsing, note previews, saved shortcuts, or full keyboard-driven selection and sorting.

relations.evidence: For customizing colors and appearance, install Style Settings plugin

summary: File browser and calendar pane that lists notes by folders, tags and properties with previews, keyboard navigation, search and periodic notes.
